paragraphs.text: Story 1
Scene 1
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。
Grammar Corrections
喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A place phrase such as “在墓地里” normally comes before the action verb it modifies.
装祭拜：假装祭拜，“假装” is the standard verb for pretending to do an action; “装” does not naturally combine with “祭拜” in this meaning.
Vocabulary Suggestions
小的时候 -- “孟子小的时候”：小时候, a shorter and very common way to refer to childhood
从早到晚 -- “从早到晚都跟朋友玩”：整天, a simpler everyday word meaning “all day”
朋友 -- “跟朋友玩”：小伙伴, a warm, child-focused word for friends who play together；同学, suitable if the friends are classmates
喜欢 -- “喜欢在墓地里玩”：爱, a stronger liking；想, focuses more on wanting to do the activity at that moment
认为 -- “妈妈认为”：觉得, a more conversational word for a personal opinion；感觉,emphasizes an impression or feeling
太近 -- “离墓地太近”：很近, describes simple physical closeness；特别近, adds stronger emphasis
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他从早到晚都跟朋友玩，On first mention, introduce a character with a full noun phrase that says who the character is before using the name or pronoun alone.
Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the previous sentence has already named the character and no competing person makes the reference unclear.
Coherence (Reference): 妈妈：孟子的妈妈，On first mention, introduce this character with a full noun phrase so the relationship is explicit.
Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，Use 了 for the completed moving event; with the verb-object phrase, it follows the verb as in “搬了家.”
Expressiveness: At the cemetery-play spot, add Mengzi’s feeling to make his action clearer: “孟子觉得祭拜很好玩。”
Expressiveness: After the children’s game, add a small visual detail: “他们学着大人的样子，认真地祭拜。”
Expressiveness: At the mother’s reason for moving, add her inner thought or speech: “妈妈很担心，心想：‘这儿不适合孟子。’”
Encouragement
You use clear time expressions such as “从早到晚” and “五岁的时候” to organize the scene. The contrast pattern “不是……而是……” also clearly explains the mother’s reason.
Scene 2
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。
Grammar Corrections
住离墓地太近：住得离墓地太近，A verb followed by a degree phrase needs the complement marker 得: 住得 + adjective phrase.
害得孟子的心气：影响了孟子的心气，害得 must be followed by a result clause describing what happened to someone; 影响了 means “affected” and can directly take the noun phrase 心气.
老是读书：一直读书，老是 has a negative, complaining connotation. Use 一直 for neutral or positive continued reading.
Vocabulary Suggestions
认为 -- “妈妈认为”：觉得，a very common and slightly more conversational way to express an opinion；想，a simpler everyday choice for a character’s thought.
搬到 -- “搬到子思老师的家”：搬去，emphasizes moving toward that destination；搬家，focuses on the act of changing homes rather than the destination.
打扫 -- “打扫房间”：收拾，an everyday word that can include tidying as well as cleaning；清理，focuses a little more on making a space clean.
房间 -- “打扫房间”：屋子，a common, more casual word for a room or small home；家里，refers more broadly to the home rather than one particular room.
做饭 -- “打扫房间和做饭”：做菜，specifically means preparing dishes；煮饭，focuses on cooking a meal, especially rice.
教 -- “教她的儿子”：教导，sounds a little more like guiding a child’s learning and behavior；辅导，focuses on helping someone study.
读书 -- “一直读书”：看书，a very common everyday phrase for reading books；学习，broader than reading and can include doing schoolwork.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 跟子思老师住：跟他住，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: 子思老师 was named earlier in the same sentence, and no other possiblemale referent has appeared.
Coherence (Temporality): 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家：孟子和孟母搬到了子思老师的家，Use 了 for the completed action of moving to a new home.
Coherence (Conjunction): 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他一直读书：因为孟子现在没有朋友，所以他一直读书，Use 因为……所以…… to clearly mark the cause-and-effect relation.
Expressiveness: After the move, add Mengzi’s feeling about studying in the new environment, for example: “孟子觉得这里很安静，能好好看书。”
Expressiveness: When Zisi teaches Mengzi, add one short line of dialogue to show the teaching, for example: “子思老师说：‘你要认真学习。’”
Expressiveness: Add a detail showing Mengmu’s reaction after seeing Mengzi read, for example: “孟母看见孟子在看书，很高兴。”
Encouragement
You clearly introduced the main people in this scene, including 子思老师, and you showed how each person helps another person.
Your final sentence gives a clear reason for Mengzi’s change in behavior, which helps the scene feel connected.
Scene 3
子思认为，对孩子来说，读书最重要，特别是学哲学。孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书。孟子从五岁一直学哲学。他才五岁就学哲学，难怪他成为很有名的哲学家。
Grammar Corrections
Nothing to flag.
Vocabulary Suggestions
认为 -- “子思认为”：觉得, a more everyday word for a personal opinion；想, a simple choice when expressing what someone thinks
重要 -- “读书最重要”：主要, emphasizes that reading is the main priority；很重要, as lightly softer everyday expression
特别 -- “特别是学哲学”：尤其, commonly emphasizes one item within a larger group；最重要的是, gives stronger emphasis to the following point
练习 -- “练习写文章”：学习, emphasizes learning how to write rather than practicing a skill；学着, emphasizes trying to learn by doing
哲学书 -- “看哲学书”：哲学方面的书, a broader phrase for books related to philosophy；哲学的书, a simple alternative with the same meaning
有名 -- “很有名的哲学家”：出名, an everyday synonym meaning well known；很著名, a slightly more formal way to say “very famous”
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 孟子从五岁一直学哲学：他从五岁一直学哲学，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: the previous sentence already names 孟子, and no other person competes as the referent.
Coherence (Temporality): 从五岁一直学哲学：从五岁开始，一直在学哲学，Use 开始 to mark the starting point, and use 一直在 + verb for an ongoing action that continues overtime.
Coherence (Temporality): 成为很有名的哲学家：成为了很有名的哲学家，Use 了 with 成为 to mark the completed change of state in the later result of the story.
Expressiveness: After “孟子不是练习写文章，就是看哲学书,” add a feeling to show his attitude toward learning, such as “他觉得哲学很有意思。”
Expressiveness: At the end, add a short comment from 子思 to make the scene more lively, such as “子思说：‘你要认真读书。’”
Expressiveness: Add one simple detail about his study habits after “一直在学哲学,” such as “他每天早上都看书。”
Encouragement
You use the “不是……就是……” pattern well to show that 孟子 spends his time on two kinds of study. Your final sentence also clearly connects his early learning with his later success.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Required Scene 3 is missing: after leaving the graveyard, 孟母 and 孟子 should move near a market, where 孟子 imitates buying and selling every day.
Required Scene 4 is misremembered: they should move from the market to a neighborhood near a school because 孟子 begins to study there. In Scene 2, they move directly to 子思老师’s home instead.
Overall Encouragement You included the graveyard, 孟母’s reason for moving, and Mengzi’s final success as a famous philosopher. Your story also clearly shows that Mengzi becomes interested in studying.
Story 2
Scene 1
有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。
Grammar Corrections
不合适的地方让孩子玩：不适合让孩子玩儿的地方，Use the pattern “适合 + someone +verb” or “适合让 + someone + verb” to describe whether a place is suitable for an activity.
决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方：决定带着孟子搬家，找更好的地方，Mental-state verbs such as “决定” normally take the zero particle rather than “了”; this revision also gives the mother a clear action she can decide to do.
住在这儿教育不太好：这儿的教育不太好，Use “Place + 的 + noun” when the place modifies the noun “教育.”
Vocabulary Suggestions
有一天 -- “有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿”：某一天, this is slightly more specific and narrative in tone；一天, this is shorter and simple when the exact day is unimportant.
墓地 -- “去了墓地玩儿”：坟地, a common everyday alternative that focuses more directly on graves；墓园, a common alternative with a slightly more formal tone.
恐怕 -- “她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福”：担心, this directly expresses the mother’s worry；害怕, this is stronger and expresses fear rather than concern.
幸福 -- “童年不会幸福”：快乐, this focuses on feeling happy day to day；开心, this is amore casual everyday word for happiness.
望子成龙 -- “因为她望子成龙”：希望儿子有出息, this explains the idiom in a clear, everyday way；希望儿子成功, this is simpler and more direct.
质量好的教育 -- “找到质量好的教育”：高质量的教育, this is a common collocation for education of good quality；更好的教育, this is simpler and compares the new education with the current one.
更近 -- “离城市更近的地方”：近一点, this gives a softer sense of being somewhat closer；城市附近, this describes a place near the city without making a direct comparison.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Expressiveness: After “她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福,” add the mother’s feeling and thought, for example: “她很担心，心想：‘我不能让孟子在这儿长大。’”
Expressiveness: At “孟子去了墓地玩儿,” add a concrete detail about what he does there, for example: “他看见很多人来祭拜，也学着他们的样子。”
Expressiveness: At the new home near the city, describe the environment with a simple sensory detail, for example: “那儿每天都有很多人，街上很热闹。”

Encouragement You clearly show the mother’s reason for moving, and you use a cause-and-effect structure with “因为……所以……” well. You also connect this scene to the next place with “然后,” which makes the events easy to follow.
Scene 2
他们住才一月就又搬家。古代的时候，一般人不喜欢卖东西的人。但是孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿，害得妈妈着急得很，因为她恐怕儿子会成为跟他们很像。她告诉了孟子：他们不是朋友，而是不好的人。
Grammar Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，Use “在古代” for a general historical time setting; “古代的时候” is not the natural form here.
老是跟这些卖东西的人常常玩儿：老是跟这些卖东西的人玩儿，Both “老是” and “常常”express a repeated habit, so only one should modify the verb phrase.
害得妈妈着急得很：让妈妈很着急，“害得” should introduce a clearly harmful result; for causing someone to feel worried, “让” is the appropriate verb.
成为跟他们很像：成为一个跟他们很像的人，“成为” needs a noun phrase after it. Here,“一个……的人” supplies the needed noun.
Vocabulary Suggestions
住 -- “他们住才一月”：待，This common verb emphasizes staying in a place, often temporarily；生活，This emphasizes daily life in that place rather than simply residing there.
搬家 -- “就又搬家”：换个地方住，This is a simple everyday way to describe moving home；搬到别的地方，This makes the destination change more explicit.
一般人 -- “一般人不喜欢”：很多人，This means a large number of people rather than people in general；有些人，This makes the statement less absolute.
不喜欢 -- “不喜欢卖东西的人”：不太喜欢，This gives a softer, less strong dislike；不爱，This is a common, more casual alternative in speech.
卖东西的人 -- “这些卖东西的人”：商人，This is a common noun for people who buy and sell goods；做生意的人，This emphasizes that selling is their work.
着急 -- “妈妈着急得很”：担心，This focuses more on worrying about a possible future result；着急，This focuses more on an immediate worried or hurried feeling.
告诉 -- “她告诉了孟子”：对孟子说，This is especially natural before direct speech；提醒，This means telling someone something so that they remember or pay attention.
Coherence & Expressiveness

Coherence (Temporality): 他们住才一月就又搬家。：他们才住了一个月，就又搬家了。For a completed period before another completed event, place “才” before the verb and use “了” with the completed actions; use “一个月” for a duration of one month.
Expressiveness: After “这些卖东西的人,” add a simple setting detail to show why the place attracts孟子, such as “这里每天都有很多人买东西，热闹极了。”
Expressiveness: At “孟子老是跟这些卖东西的人玩儿,” show what he copies: “他还学着他们收钱、卖东西。”
Expressiveness: After “妈妈着急得很,” add the mother’s inner thought or speech: “妈妈心想：‘如果他一直这样，以后怎么办呢？’”
Encouragement
You clearly show the mother’s concern and explain why she is worried, which gives the scene a strong cause-and-effect relationship.
Your use of direct speech in “她告诉了孟子” helps make the scene feel more active.
Scene 3
你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。
Grammar Corrections
他们第三个家：他们的第三个家，A possessive pronoun before an ordinal, classifier, and noun normally needs 的.
Vocabulary Suggestions
搬家 -- “他们又搬家”：搬到别的地方, this makes the change of location more explicit；搬走, this is a shorter everyday choice that emphasizes leaving the old home
学习 -- “从早到晚学习”：读书, this focuses more specifically on reading and studying books；用功学习, this adds the idea of working hard
感觉 -- “妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们”：觉得, this is a very common choice for stating an opinion or judgment；认为, this sounds slightly more definite and thoughtful
适合 -- “这个地方适合他们”：合适, this is a common alternative meaning suitable or appropriate；很适合住, this specifies that the place is suitable for living
告诉 -- “告诉了孟子”：对孟子说, this introduces direct speech in a more conversational way；跟孟子说, this is another common everyday choice
有名 -- “有名的哲学家”：出名, this is a common alternative that emphasizes becoming well known；很有名, this adds stronger emphasis
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 他：孟子，Repeat the name when another character, 妈妈, and a competing noun phrase, 儿子, appear before the pronoun; the pronoun is otherwise ambiguous.
Coherence (Temporality): 告诉了孟子：告诉孟子，Use the zero particle with a saying verb that introduces quoted speech.
Coherence (Temporality): 成为：成为了，Use 了 for the completed change of state of becoming a philosopher.
Expressiveness: At “妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们,” add the mother’s relieved feeling: “妈妈很高兴，觉得这次终于搬对了。”
Expressiveness: After “从早到晚学习,” add a simple detail showing Mengzi’s effort: “孟子每天认真看书，也常常问老师问题。”
Expressiveness: Make the opening dialogue more emotional by showing the mother’s concern: “妈妈着急地说：‘你不能老是学卖东西。’”
Encouragement
You used direct speech to show the mother’s thoughts, and you clearly connected Mengzi’s studying with his later success.
Your scene also uses useful time and place expressions, such as “从早到晚” and “在这儿,”to make the events easier to follow.
End-of-story content feedback
Content & Completeness
Scene 1 is missing Required Scene 1: Mengzi and his mother should live near a graveyard, and Mengzi should imitate offering sacrifices every day.
Scene 1 has Required Scene 2 only partly correct: Mengmu moves away, but the reason should specifically be that Mengzi’s imitation of sacrifices may negatively affect him.
Scene 2 is unclear and out of order for Required Scene 3: it should show that they moved near a market and Mengzi imitated buying and selling every day.
Scene 3 misremembers Required Scene 4: after leaving the market, they should move near a school, where Mengzi begins studying every day. He should not learn “怎么祭拜” in the third home.
Overall Encouragement
You included Mengmu’s care for her son and the important ending that Mengzi becomes a famous philosopher. Your story also shows that the family moves several times to find a better place for Mengzi.
Story 3
Scene 1
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。
Grammar Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，this time expression is not used naturally for a general historical setting; use the fixed expression “在古代”.
老是祭拜：常常祭拜，“老是” usually expresses a negative or complaining feeling, while“常常” neutrally describes a frequent action.
有才两个学校：才有两所学校，“才” should come before the verb “有” to show a small number, and schools use the measure word “所”.
Vocabulary Suggestions
男孩子 -- “一个男孩子”：小男孩, a more common everyday word for a young boy；男孩, a shorter, neutral choice
妈妈 -- “他的妈妈”：母亲, a slightly more formal word for one’s mother；妈妈, warmer and more conversational
住 -- “住在中国”：生活在中国, emphasizes daily life in China rather than only the place of residence；住在中国, focuses specifically on where someone lives
墓地 -- “墓地的旁边”：坟地, a more everyday word for a burial place；墓地, a more neutral and formal choice
朋友 -- “跟朋友聊天”：小伙伴, a childlike and friendly word for peers；同学, suitable if the friends are classmates
聊天 -- “跟朋友聊天”：说话, a broader word that can mean simply talking；聊一聊, a more casual and lighter way to describe chatting
很小 -- “都很小”：不大, an everyday alternative meaning “not big”；比较小, emphasizes comparison with other schools
Coherence & Expressiveness

Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。：一个叫孟子的男孩子和他的妈妈住在中国。，by the first-mention rule, introduce the character withhis name and role when he first appears, rather than naming him only in the following sentence.

Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。：他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。，by the pronoun rule, use “他” when the same character was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes as the referent.
Coherence (Reference): 但是城市：但是，by the zero-form rule, do not repeat “城市” within the same sentence when it remains the clear topic.
Expressiveness: After “常常祭拜,” add a simple feeling to show why the action interests him, such as “他觉得很好玩。”
Expressiveness: At “跟朋友聊天,” add a small action or line of speech, such as “他和朋友一边笑，一边聊天。”
Expressiveness: After “都很小,” add the mother’s reaction to make the setting more vivid, such as “妈妈觉得这里不太方便。”
Encouragement
You used the pattern “不是……就是……” well to show two activities that孟子 often does.
You also tried to connect ideas with “所以” and “但是,” which helps the scene move from the home near the cemetery to the description of the city.
Scene 2
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。
Grammar Corrections
想孟子有很好的教育：想让孟子受到很好的教育，when 想 expresses wanting another person to have or do something, use 让 before that person.
搬家：搬，搬家 is a separable verb phrase; before 到 + a destination, use the movement verb 搬 rather than placing 到 directly after 搬家.
Vocabulary Suggestions
妈妈 -- “他的妈妈”：母亲，a slightly more formal word for “mother”；孟母，this is a useful name-based way to refer to Mencius’s mother in this story.
城市 -- “他们的城市”：地方，a broader, everyday word that can mean a place or area, not specifically a city；城里，a more casual way to mean “in the city.”
很好 -- “很好的教育”：不错，an everyday alternative meaning “quite good”；更好，use this when comparing the new education with the old one.
教育 -- “很好的教育”：学校教育，this specifically refers to education received through school；学习环境，this emphasizes whether the place is good for studying.
很多 -- “有很多学校”：许多，a common alternative with a slightly more written tone；不少，an everyday choice meaning “quite a lot.”
一直 -- “孟子一直抱怨”：总是，a common alternative for something that happens repeatedly；不停地，this stresses that the complaining continues without stopping.
抱怨 -- “孟子一直抱怨”：埋怨，a close synonym that can sound a little stronger；说不高兴的话，a simpler phrase that focuses on what Mengzi says.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 到：到了，this move is a completed event in the narrative, so the verb takes 了.
Coherence (Temporality): 从早到晚走路：从早到晚走了路，this describes a completed stretch of walking during this move, so use 了 for the completed action.
Expressiveness: After “孟子一直抱怨,” add a short line of speech to show his feelings: “孟子说：‘妈妈，我们还要走多久？’”
Expressiveness: Add one simple physical detail about the long walk: “他走得很累，脚也疼。”
Expressiveness: Show the mother’s response at this point: “妈妈说：‘快到了，再坚持一下。’”
Encouragement

You clearly explain the mother’s reason for moving and use the contrast pattern “不是……而是……” to connect her two ideas. You also use “从早到晚” and “一直抱怨” well to show that the journey feels long and difficult for Mengzi.
Scene 3
他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市。他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。跟老师孟子学最重要的文学，所以他成为哲学家。
Grammar Corrections
他难怪抱怨：难怪他抱怨，an adverb such as “难怪” normally comes before the subject it comments on.
他不要离开：他不想离开，“不要” is usually used for an instruction, prohibition, or refusal; “不想” expresses that someone does not want to do something.
找到孟子一个老师：给孟子找一个老师，use “给” before the person who receives the benefit of the action; the mother finds a teacher for Mengzi.
跟老师孟子学：孟子跟老师学，place the subject “孟子” before the phrase beginning with “跟老师.”
Vocabulary Suggestions
抱怨 -- “难怪他抱怨”：不高兴，an everyday way to focus on Mengzi’s unhappy feeling rather than the act of complaining；埋怨，a slightly stronger word for complaining that suggests blaming the situation or someone.
想 -- “他想他的朋友”：想念，more clearly means that he misses friends who are not with him；挂念，means worrying about or missing someone, with a caring tone.
离开 -- “离开他的城市”：搬走，an everyday choice when the family is moving away from a place；走开，usually means leaving a nearby place, so it creates a more immediate feeling.
城市 -- “他的城市”：地方，a more general everyday word for the place where he lives；家乡, specifically means one’s hometown and gives the place a more personal feeling.
老师 -- “一个老师”：教师，a more formal word for a teacher；先生，can be used respectfully for a male teacher in some contexts.
学 -- “孟子跟老师学”：学习，slightly more formal and suitable for describing school learning；读书，specifically emphasizes studying by reading books.
最重要 -- “最重要的文学”：很重要，less absolute and useful when there are several important subjects；主要，means “main” or “primary” and can describe a main area of study.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 所以他成为哲学家：所以孟子成为哲学家，repeat the name when another male character, the teacher, has appeared in between; the pronoun “他”could otherwise refer to either person.
Coherence (Temporality): 找到：找了，use “了” for the completed action of the mother finding a teacher.
Coherence (Temporality): 成为哲学家：成为了哲学家，use “了” to mark the completed change of state: Mengzi later became a philosopher.
Coherence (Conjunction): 他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市：因为他想念朋友，也不想离开他的城市，put both reasons after “因为” so that the cause-and-effect connection clearly explains why he complains.
Expressiveness: After the complaint, add Mengzi’s feeling to show that moving is difficult for him: “孟子很不高兴，也很想念朋友。”
Expressiveness: Add a short line of speech after his mother finds the teacher: “孟子说：‘我会认真学习。’”
Expressiveness: Describe his learning with one concrete detail before the final result: “孟子每天跟老师读书，也问很多问题。”
Encouragement
You clearly connected Mengzi’s complaint to his wish to stay in his city, and you also included an important later outcome: he became a philosopher.
Your scene uses several useful story words, including “抱怨,” “老师,” “文学,” and “哲学家.”

Scene 1
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

Grammar Corrections
古代的时候：在古代， Use “在古代” to introduce the historical time; “古代的时候” is not the natural expression here.
一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到很多人正在吃一些植物，Use “看到” when the meaning is “see” a completed visual result. “看” means “look,” while “看到” means “catch sight of/see.”

别人：大家/他们， “别人” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
Vocabulary Suggestions
路上 -- “正在路上走”：路边，This means “by the side of the road,” so it gives a more specific location；路上，This is already a natural general phrase for being on the road.
很多人 -- “很多人正在吃一些植物”：许多人，This is a common synonym with a slightly more neutral written tone；好多人，This is more conversational and emphasizes that the number feels large.
吃 -- “正在吃一些植物”：尝，This means “taste,” and it is useful when someone tries an unfamiliar plant；吃下，This emphasizes swallowing or consuming something.
生病 -- “一吃植物就生病了”：不舒服，This is less serious and can describe general physical discomfort；病了，This is a shorter everyday way to say that someone became ill.
帮 -- “想帮别人”：帮助，This is a common two-character alternative with a slightly more written tone；照顾，This means “take care of” and fits when the help involves caring for sick people.
想 -- “想知道哪些植物能吃”：希望，This expresses a wish or hope more strongly；打算, This emphasizes a plan to find out.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。：因为神农想帮别人，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。“因为……所以……” clearly marks the cause-and-effect relation: wanting to help people is the reason for finding out which plants are safe.
Expressiveness: After the people become ill, add Shennong’s feeling to show why he decides to help: “神农看见他们生病了，心里很着急。 ”
Expressiveness: Add a short thought to make his decision more vivid: “他想：我一定要找出能吃的植物。 ”
Expressiveness: Describe the plants with one simple detail at the moment people are eating them: “有的人吃绿色的叶子，有的人吃红色的小果子。 ”
Encouragement
You clearly introduce the main character and use “正在” well to show an action in progress. You also make the problem easy to understand by connecting people eating plants with becoming sick.
Scene 2
然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

Grammar Corrections
一些植物吃真好：一些植物吃起来真好，Use the complement structure “verb + 起来 + adjective” to describe how something feels or tastes when eaten.
植物毒得很：植物有毒， “有毒” is the standard expression for a poisonous plant; “毒得很” does not fit this meaning naturally.
Vocabulary Suggestions
然后 -- “然后，神农开始尝很多植物”：后来，this also marks sequence, but it is often used when some time has passed before the next event；接着，this means the next action happened immediately after the previous one.
开始 -- “神农开始尝很多植物”：先，this can show that trying plants is the first step in a sequence；着手，this means beginning a task and is slightly more formal.
尝 -- “尝很多植物”：试，this is a common alternative when someone tests whether something is suitable or safe；尝试，this emphasizes trying something new or uncertain.
很多 -- “很多植物”：各种，this emphasizes different kinds rather than only a large number；不少，this means “quite a few” and sounds a little less exact.
比方说 -- “比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜”：例如，this is a common, slightly more written-style way to introduce examples；比如，this is a shorter and more conversational alternative.
吃过 -- “他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜”：尝过，this focuses more specifically on tasting these foods；吃了，this simply reports a completed eating action, without emphasizing past experience.
特别是 -- “特别是黄瓜”：尤其是，this gives slightly stronger emphasis to the example；比如，this can introduce one example in a more neutral way.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Expressiveness: When introducing the safe plants, add a simple description of taste, such as “黄瓜又脆又好吃。 ”
Expressiveness: At the poisonous-plant sentence, describe the flowers to create contrast, such as “夹竹桃开着黄色的花，像星星一样漂亮。”
Expressiveness: Add Shen Nong’s uncertain feeling before he tries unfamiliar plants, such as “神农想：这种植物能吃吗？ ”
Encouragement
You use clear sequence language with “然后” and give specific examples of plants, which makes the scene easy to follow. The contrast between plants that are good to eat and dangerous plants is also a strong idea.
Scene 3
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

Grammar Corrections
麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：请问，我们可以吃什么植物， "麻烦" does not introduce a question in this way; "请问" is the polite expression used before asking a question.
这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是哪种植物了，this pattern must answer the uncertain question about which plants can be eaten; the relevant condition is the type of plant, not whether someone wants to become ill.
以后，神农告诉别人：后来，神农告诉别人， "以后" follows a completed event or time
phrase, while "后来" introduces a later event at the beginning of a sentence.

Vocabulary Suggestions
对……说 -- "一个人对神农说"：问，this is more direct when the following words are a question；跟……说， this is a common, conversational alternative.
告诉 -- "神农告诉别人"：跟……说，this sounds more casual and is useful for spoken information；解释， this emphasizes explaining information clearly.
别人 -- "告诉别人"：大家，this means a group of people and sounds more inclusive；人们，this refers to people in general.
植物 -- "什么植物"：花草，this is a common everyday word for flowers and plants；药草，this specifically refers to plants used as medicine.
能吃 -- "一些植物能吃"：可以吃，this is an equally common way to say that something is safe or allowed to eat；能吃的， this form can describe a noun, such as edible plants.
不能吃 -- "一些植物不能吃"：不可以吃， this is a common alternative with a slightly clearer sense of “should not”；有毒， this specifically explains that a plant is unsafe because it is poisonous.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Expressiveness: After the question, add a short feeling or concern to show why the person is asking: “我怕吃了会生病。 ”
Expressiveness: When introducing the useful plants, add one simple example: “比如，生姜对身体有好处。 ”
Expressiveness: Add a brief line of speech for a clearer, more lively explanation: “有毒的植物不能吃。 ”
Encouragement
You clearly connect this scene to the earlier idea of learning which plants are safe, and you correctly use the contrast between “能吃” and “不能吃.” Your short dialogue also gives the scene a clear focus.

Scene 1
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Grammar Corrections
古代的时候：在古代，use “在古代” for this general historical time setting; “古代的时候” is not the natural expression here.
他找很多植物：他找到了很多植物，“找” means “to look for,” while “找到” means “to find”; use “了” because this is a completed action in the narrative.
Vocabulary Suggestions
有意思 -- “植物很有意思”：有趣, a common synonym that focuses more directly on being interesting；好玩, a more casual word often used for something enjoyable or fun.
男人 -- “一个男人”：男子, a slightly more neutral word for an adult male；人, a broader, simpler word when the character’s gender is not important.
有的 -- “有的植物”：一些, a common choice meaning “some” and often used before a noun；有些, similar to “一些,” with a slightly stronger sense of “certain ones.”
肚子疼死了 -- “他的肚子疼死了”：肚子很疼, a more neutral description of pain；肚子疼得不得了, still strong but more clearly describes the degree of pain.
舒服 -- “很舒服”：好受, especially natural when describing feeling better after pain or illness；轻松, suggests feeling relaxed or free from discomfort.
可是 -- “可是有的”：但是, an equally common contrast connector with a slightly more formal tone；不过, a softer contrast often used in speaking.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。：一个叫神农的男人觉得植物很有意思。follow the first-mention rule by introducing the character’s name together with a full noun phrase when he first appears.
Expressiveness: After “肚子疼死了,” add an action showing Shen Nong’s pain, such as “他马上躺在地上，难受得不得了。 ”
Expressiveness: After “很舒服,” add his feeling or thought to make the change clearer, such as “神农觉得很奇怪：这种植物为什么能让我舒服？ ”
Expressiveness: When mentioning the plants, add one simple visual detail, such as “有的植物开着黄色的花，又大又漂亮。 ”
Encouragement
You clearly showed the contrast between harmful and helpful plants with “可是,” and “肚子疼死了” strongly communicates Shen Nong’s painful experience.
Scene 2
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。
Grammar Corrections
凉山：爬上，The original phrase has no action verb. Use the directional verb complement “爬上” to describe going up a mountain.
很大的山：一座很大的山，A countable mountain needs the measure word “座” after the number.
这也：在这儿，Use “在” before a location. “也” means “also” and cannot serve as the location word “这儿.”
跟黄色的花做茶：用这种黄色的花做，Use “用” to introduce the material used to make something; “跟” does not fit this making-with-materials meaning.
做茶很有用：做的茶很有用，Add “的” to make the phrase “用这种黄色的花做的茶” the subject; it means “the tea made with this yellow flower.”
你的头发疼死：你头疼得要死，“头疼” is the usual word for having a headache; use “得” before a degree complement such as “要死.”

这冰茶：这种冰茶，这/那 + MW. + noun. 
Vocabulary Suggestions
大 -- “很大的山”：高大的，This describes a mountain as both tall and large；非常大的，This is a slightly stronger everyday intensifier than “很大.”
找 -- “找植物”：寻找，This is a common, slightly more written alternative for looking for something；找一找，This gives the action a more casual, exploratory feeling.
黄色 -- “黄色的花”：金黄色，This gives a brighter, more specific yellow color；黄黄的，This is a simple, more conversational description.
听说 -- “他听说”：听别人说， This makes it clearer that the information came from other people；听到， This focuses on hearing a specific piece of information.
有用 -- “很有用”：有帮助，This emphasizes that something helps people；对身体好，This is more specific when describing food, tea, or medicine.
比方说 -- “比方说”：比如，This is a shorter, very common way to introduce an example；例如， This has a slightly more written tone.
不舒服 -- “很不舒服”：难受，This often expresses a stronger physical unpleasant feeling；不太舒服，This sounds milder and less serious.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 你：删除“你”，The pronoun “你” has no introduced referent. This is a first-mention reference problem because the reader does not know who the addressee is.
Coherence (Temporality): 找到：找到了，Use “了” for the completed action of finding a flower in this past narrative event.
Expressiveness: When the yellow flower appears, add one simple visual detail: “那儿开着一朵黄色的花，像星星一样。 ”
Expressiveness: After the tea makes him feel ill, show his physical feeling more clearly: “他肚子很疼，难受得不得了。 ”
Expressiveness: Add a short thought to show his worry at that moment: “他想： ‘我怎么了？ ’”
Encouragement
You used time order with “一天” and tried the useful pattern “一……就……,” which helps the events move forward. You also included a clear physical reaction after drinking the tea, giving the scene an important feeling change.

糟糕 -- “糟糕，这黄色的花……”：不好了，a common expression that sounds like an immediate reaction to bad news；糟了，a shorter, more spoken reaction.
黄色 -- “黄色的花”：金黄色，describes a deeper, brighter yellow；黄颜色的，a more everyday descriptive phrase.
花 -- “黄色的花”：花朵，a common alternative that sounds slightly more specific；花儿，a warmer, more conversational choice.
正好 -- “正好在这儿”：刚好，an equally common alternative meaning “just at this time/place”；正是在，emphasizes that the event happened at that exact place.

Story 8

Scene 1
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

Grammar Corrections
古代时候：在古代的时候，A time expression needs a structure such as “在 + time + 的时候”; the original phrase is incomplete.
试一试很多种植物：尝一尝很多种植物，“试” means to test something, while “尝” means to taste or eat a plant to find out its effects.
什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物安全，什么植物危险，When an adjective such as “安全” or “危险” is the predicate, it can directly describe the plant; the original needs clearer parallel structure and a separator between the two questions.
Vocabulary Suggestions
常常 -- “常常一吃就死”：经常, an equally common synonym for something that happens frequently；老是, a more conversational choice that can suggest the situation happens repeatedly and negatively. 
办法 -- “没有办法”：方法, a common alternative that focuses on a practical way of solving a problem；主意, an everyday word for an idea or plan. 
有一天 -- “所以有一天”：后来, an everyday sequence word meaning “later,” useful when moving the story forward；一天, a simpler time expression when the exact narrative opening is not needed
很多种 -- “很多种植物”：多种, a shorter and slightly more formal way to say “many kinds”；各种, meaning “all kinds of,” which gives a broader sense. 
安全 -- “什么植物是安全”：无毒, a more specific word for a plant that is not poisonous；没有危险, an everyday phrase meaning that there is no danger. 
危险 -- “什么是危险”：有毒, a more specific choice when the danger comes from poison；不安全, an everyday opposite of “安全”. 
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 人不知道他们能吃什么植物：人们不知道什么植物能吃，For a generic group, use one consistent noun phrase; “他们” is unnecessary after “人” and makes the reference less clear.
Coherence (Reference): 神农：一位叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than using only his name.
Coherence (Temporality): 告诉人：告诉了人们，This is the last action in a completed series of past events, so it needs “了”; use “人们” for the people being told.
Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：因为不知道为什么，所以没有办法，Use “因为……所以……” for the cause-and-effect relation: not knowing the reason causes people to have no solution.
Expressiveness: After “常常一吃就死,” add people’s feelings to make the danger more vivid: “人们都很害怕。 ”
Expressiveness: At the point where Shen Nong appears, add his thought or speech to show his purpose: “神农想： ‘我要找出能吃的植物。 ’”
Expressiveness: Describe one small action as he begins his search: “他拿着一些植物，认真地看一看。 ”
Encouragement
You clearly establish the problem first and then introduce Shen Nong’s goal, which gives the scene a logical direction.
The pattern “一吃就死” is a strong, concise way to show an immediate and serious result.
Scene 2
发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚。他告诉朋友： “你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味。比方说，你爱吃甜的，可能喜欢糖。 ”他最喜欢吃花，除了夹竹桃以外，什么都花想吃。

Grammar Corrections
让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：让人觉得肚子又暖和又舒服，清楚 describes information or thinking, not a physical feeling in the stomach; 舒服 naturally describes bodily comfort.

发现 -- “发现有的植物对身体非常好”：注意到，this focuses on noticing something; 看到，this is a simpler choice meaning “see,” with less emphasis on making a discovery.
非常 -- “对身体非常好”：很，an equally common and slightly more neutral intensifier; 特别，an everyday alternative that gives extra emphasis.
特别是 -- “特别是茶”：比如，a shorter, common way to introduce an example; 像，an informal everyday option for giving an example.
暖和 -- “又暖和又清楚”：温暖，this has a gentler feeling and can describe warmth in the body.
告诉 -- “他告诉朋友”：对……说，this is more natural when directly introducing spoken words; 跟……说，a common conversational alternative.
口味 -- “看你的口味”：喜好，this means personal preference more generally, while 口味 is especially connected with food preferences.
比方说 -- “比方说，你爱吃甜的”：比如说，an equally common alternative with a slightly more conversational tone; 例如，a somewhat more neutral option for introducing an example.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Temporality): 你吃哪种植物，这就要看你的口味：你想吃哪种植物？这就要
看你的口味了，this fixed expression needs an open question or uncertain condition before it, and it normally ends with 了.
Expressiveness: After “特别是茶,” add a simple detail about how tea is used: “他把茶放在水里，茶水很好喝。 ”
Expressiveness: Show his feeling when he finds a helpful plant: “他很高兴，觉得自己学到了很多。 ”
Expressiveness: Make the advice to his friend more lively with a short response: “朋友说： ‘原来每个人喜欢吃的东西不一样。 ’”
Encouragement
You used direct speech well to show what the character says to a friend, rather than only listing events.
Your sentence about tea gives a clear physical effect, and “除了夹竹桃以外” shows that you are trying to make careful comparisons.
Scene 3
他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

Grammar Corrections
他发现这个口味：他发现自己这个偏好，“口味” means food preferences, particularly preferences for tastes. Here it is inappropriate. 偏好 “preference” is better. 这个偏好 refers to the earlier “喜欢吃花”, “这个” is vague, add “自己” to connect to the earlier text.

毒的花：有毒的花，Use the adjective phrase with 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant or flower.
一百岁时候：一百岁的时候，A time phrase followed by 时候 needs the structural particle 的.

开始死：快要死了，开始 introduces an ongoing action or process, while 死 is an endpoint or change of state; use 快要……了 for being close to death.
什么植物是毒：什么植物有毒，Use 有毒 to say that a plant is poisonous; 是毒 does not fit this meaning.
Vocabulary Suggestions
发现 -- “他发现这个口味”：找到，This emphasizes finding something after looking or searching.
不小心 -- “不小心吃了”：一不小心，This is an equally common phrase that makes the accidental moment feel more sudden.
吃 -- “吃了毒的花”：尝，This means to taste or try a small amount, which can fit trying a plant.
生病 -- “生病时候”：病了，This emphasizes the change into becoming ill.
告诉 -- “告诉人”：说，This is more conversational and focuses on speaking the information aloud；说明， This focuses on explaining information clearly.
植物 -- “什么植物”：花草，This is a common, simpler choice when referring specifically to flowers and grasses.
Coherence & Expressiveness
Coherence (Reference): 人：人们，Use a fuller noun phrase when the group of people is not specific; the bare noun 人 is too vague here.
Coherence (Temporality): 发现：发现了，Use 了 for a completed discovery in a past narrative.
Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，Use 了 for the completed action of giving people this information in the narrative.
Expressiveness: After the flower is eaten, add a simple visual detail about it: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样。 ”
Expressiveness: At the moment of illness, show a physical feeling: “他肚子疼了起来，躺在地上。 ”
Expressiveness: Add an inner thought to show fear: “我会死吗？ ”
Encouragement
You used the time-linking pattern “一吃就……” effectively to show that the problem happened immediately after eating. You also clearly tried to explain the important difference between plants that are medicine and plants that are poisonous.
End-of-story content feedback

Content & Completeness
Scene 1 misremembers the problem: people often became sick after eating unknown plants, rather than usually dying.
Scene 2 includes finding tea, but it needs to show 神农 making a record about it.
Scene 3 does not correctly show 神农 eating 夹竹桃 and fainting.
Required Scene 5 is missing: a person in blue gives 神农 灵芝, and he feels better after eating it.
Required Scene 6 is missing: a person in brown comes and talks with 神农.
Required Scene 7 is missing: 神农 records both 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
Overall Encouragement
You included the important ancient-time setting, 神农’s goal of testing plants, and the discovery of tea. Your story also shows that 神农 wants to help other people know which plants are safe.
